title: The emerging winners and losers in the AI scribe market
html:
This is the web edition of STAT’s AI Prognosis newsletter, our guide to artificial intelligence in health care and medicine. Sign up to get it delivered in your inbox every Wednesday.

Today’s the day! If you’re at HLTH, come down to the Startup Acceleration Zone this morning for the STAT stage takeover. I’ll be talking EHRs with Epic and others from the industry; Lisa Bari of Innovaccer and Kristen Valdes of b.well will be talking with my colleague Matt Herper about whether patient data can unleash AI, and Mario will be talking to Whoop’s Ami Bhatt, Verily’s Carolyn Jasik, and ARPA-H’s Haider Warraich about “Bridging the AI Gap.”

It will be so fun; you don’t want to miss it.
